description: Original demonstration scripts; offline synthetic narration, no real voice impersonation or historical recording.

samples.name: promise-zh
samples.script: 这是一则虚构的红色家风故事。老党员在家书里写道，答应群众的事，要认真做到。孙女读完信，决定从身边的小事尽责。

samples.name: promise-en
samples.script: An original fictional story. In a family letter, a veteran Party member wrote: keep the promises you make to the community. After reading it, a granddaughter chose to take responsibility through small acts of service.

samples.name: integrity-zh
samples.script: 这是一则原创清廉故事。孩子问，家里的纸能用单位的吗？父亲说，公家的东西要留给公事。清廉，始于日常的选择。

samples.name: integrity-en
samples.script: An original story about integrity. A child asked if they could bring paper home from the office. The parent said, public supplies are for public work. Integrity begins with everyday choices.

samples.name: zhuge-liang-zh
samples.script: 欢迎走进诸葛亮主题展。静以修身，俭以养德。请从一段家训出发，思考今天能够实践的一件小事。

samples.name: zhuge-liang-en
samples.script: Welcome to this gallery about Zhuge Liang. Explore calmness, simple living and self cultivation. Begin with one precept and consider a small action you can practise today.

samples.name: yan-zhitui-zh
samples.script: 欢迎走进颜之推主题展。学习不仅在书本，也在观察和实践中。请想一想，怎样把今天学到的道理用于生活。

samples.name: yan-zhitui-en
samples.script: Welcome to this gallery about Yan Zhitui. Learning grows through books, observation and practice. Consider how one idea you learned today could guide everyday life.
